summary: Iteration 26 backend testing — messaging multi-channel (context + send), preferences (getyourguide_url + cleaning_offset_days with auto-cleaning regeneration), Airbnb tourist-tax split in owner statement, and inbox thread reservation_id. All 12 executed backend tests pass; 1 test skipped due to no channel_settings/api_key configured in QA env (inbox thread requires adapter). Real email send via Resend to delivered@resend.dev verified OK. Code review of /api/inbox/{thread_uid} confirms reservation_id is derived from db.reservations lookup and included in the response payload.
action_items: None — all backend endpoints under review behave as specified. Only the inbox thread test is skipped because the QA env has no channel_settings.api_key; the 'reservation_id' addition is verified via code review (backend/routers/inbox.py line 78-82). Main agent can retest this after connecting a channel manager, or write a unit test that stubs get_channel_adapter.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/messaging.py:83 — email 'to' is trimmed but not validated as a well-formed email; malformed guest_email would be forwarded to Resend and could fail silently. Consider a basic regex check.

backend/routers/messaging.py:82-100 — no distinction between validation errors and provider (Resend/Channex) errors: if send_email raises, the client receives a 500 with no context. Wrapping in try/except and returning {sent:false, reason:'provider_error', detail:str(e)} would be friendlier.

backend/routers/preferences.py:104-108 — cleaning_offset_days is clamped 0..14 but the change-detection reads only cleaning_offset_days from prev; if the doc doesn't exist yet (first PUT for a new user) the diff still triggers regen only when new_offset != 0. Acceptable but worth noting.

backend/routers/statements.py:70-72 — the Airbnb branch attributes the FULL tourist tax to Airbnb; if a property has both séjour and regional taxes and Airbnb only collects séjour, the regional portion would be under-reported. Current spec matches the requested behavior, but this edge case may surface later.
seed_data_creation: All test data is created inside the test with TEST_QA_ prefix and cleaned up in teardown (no persistent seed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_messaging_preferences.py — it covers messaging/context, messaging/send (all 5 branches), preferences GET/PUT with clamp + regen, owner-statement Airbnb tax split, inbox thread reservation_id (skipped without channel_settings). Auth uses QA Admin email/password. If a channex/lodgify api_key is provisioned for user_e235f66c67c3, the inbox test will run automatically.
